MEMORANDUM
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Management
Date: March 4
Subject: Office Relocation to the Riverside Building

As previously announced, our company will relocate from the current Maple Street offices to the new Riverside Building starting April 15. The move will take place over the weekend of April 13-14 to minimize disruption to daily operations. All employees are asked to pack personal belongings in the labeled boxes provided by Facilities no later than April 10. IT equipment, including desktop computers and monitors, will be moved by our contracted vendor and should not be packed by staff. Parking permits for the new location will be issued during the week of April 6. Employees who currently use public transportation should note that the Riverside Building is a five-minute walk from Central Station. Please direct any questions to facilities@corpmail.com.
statement: What is the main purpose of this memo?
choices: To announce a change in parking regulations
To inform employees about an upcoming office move
To introduce a new IT equipment vendor
To announce new public transportation options

explanation.why_correct: Le mémo informe explicitement les employés du déménagement des bureaux de Maple Street vers le Riverside Building, comme indiqué dès la première phrase.
why_others_wrong: Le mémo mentionne les permis de parking mais ce n'est qu'un détail secondaire, pas l'objet principal du message.
Le mémo mentionne un prestataire pour déplacer le matériel informatique mais ce n'est pas le sujet principal, juste un détail pratique.
Le mémo mentionne la proximité de la gare mais n'introduit pas de nouvelles options de transport public.
explanation.method: Pour identifier l'idée principale, se concentrer sur les premières phrases du document et sur l'objet ('Subject') indiqué en en-tête.

From: k.martins@brightline-supplies.com
To: orders@urbanoffice.com
Subject: Delayed Order #48291

Dear Customer Service Team,

I am writing to follow up on order #48291, placed on September 2, which was supposed to arrive within seven business days according to your website. It has now been twelve days, and I have not received any shipping confirmation or tracking number. This order includes desks and chairs that we urgently need for three new employees starting next Monday.

Could you please check the status of this order and let me know when we can expect delivery? If the items cannot arrive by Friday, I would like to know whether a partial shipment is possible, or whether we should consider canceling the order and requesting a full refund.

I would appreciate a prompt response, as this delay is starting to affect our office setup schedule.

Best regards,
Karen Martins
Office Manager, Brightline Supplies
statement: Why did Karen Martins write this email?
choices: To place a new order for office furniture
To request a refund for damaged goods
To inquire about a delayed order
To thank the company for fast delivery

explanation.why_correct: Karen écrit pour faire un suivi sur une commande en retard ('follow up on order #48291...it has now been twelve days').
why_others_wrong: Elle ne passe pas une nouvelle commande, elle fait un suivi sur une commande déjà passée.
Elle ne mentionne aucun dommage sur les articles, seulement un retard de livraison.
Elle se plaint d'un retard, elle ne remercie absolument pas pour une livraison rapide.
explanation.method: Pour identifier le but d'un email professionnel, lire l'objet ('Subject') et la première phrase, qui annoncent généralement l'intention de l'auteur.

MARKETING MANAGER — Downtown Office
Halcyon Consumer Goods is seeking an experienced Marketing Manager to lead our brand strategy team. The successful candidate will develop and implement marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels, manage a team of four marketing associates, and collaborate closely with the sales department to align promotional activities with revenue targets.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
- Minimum of five years of experience in a marketing role, including at least two years in a supervisory position
- Strong analytical skills and experience with digital advertising platforms
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and a retirement savings plan. This is a full-time, on-site position based at our downtown headquarters, with occasional travel required for trade shows and client meetings.

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter to careers@halcyongoods.com by October 15.
statement: What is this document primarily about?
choices: A promotion announcement for a current employee
A job opening for a marketing position
A new marketing campaign launch
A description of a company's benefits package

explanation.why_correct: Le document est une offre d'emploi ('MARKETING MANAGER') décrivant le poste, les exigences et la façon de postuler.
why_others_wrong: Le document ne concerne pas la promotion d'un employé actuel mais le recrutement d'une nouvelle personne.
Le document ne décrit pas une campagne marketing spécifique, mais un poste à pourvoir.
Les avantages sociaux ne sont qu'une partie du texte, pas son sujet principal.
explanation.method: Le titre et la structure du document (poste, exigences, avantages, comment postuler) permettent d'identifier rapidement qu'il s'agit d'une offre d'emploi.

INTRODUCING TASKFLOW 3.0: SMARTER PROJECT MANAGEMENT

We are excited to announce the release of TaskFlow 3.0, the latest update to our popular project management software. This version introduces an AI-powered scheduling assistant that automatically suggests optimal deadlines based on team workload and project priority. Users can also now integrate TaskFlow directly with their email inbox, allowing tasks to be created from incoming messages with a single click.

Other new features include customizable dashboards, improved mobile app performance, and a redesigned reporting tool that generates weekly progress summaries automatically. Existing customers on the Professional and Enterprise plans will receive the update at no additional cost starting October 1. Customers on the Basic plan will need to upgrade their subscription to access the AI scheduling features.

For a full list of updates or to schedule a live demo, visit www.taskflowapp.com/whatsnew.
statement: What is the purpose of this announcement?
choices: To apologize for a service outage
To present new features of a software update
To announce a price increase for all plans
To recruit new software developers

explanation.why_correct: Le texte présente les nouvelles fonctionnalités de la version 3.0 du logiciel TaskFlow.
why_others_wrong: Le texte ne mentionne aucune panne de service ni excuse.
Le texte évoque une mise à jour gratuite pour certains clients, pas une hausse de prix générale.
Le texte ne concerne pas le recrutement mais la présentation d'un produit.
explanation.method: Le titre en majuscules ('INTRODUCING...') indique immédiatement qu'il s'agit de la présentation d'une nouveauté produit.

NOTICE TO ALL EMPLOYEES: UPDATED REMOTE WORK POLICY

Effective November 1, the company is updating its remote work policy. Employees may now work remotely up to three days per week, an increase from the previous limit of two days. Requests to work remotely must still be approved in advance by your direct supervisor and logged in the HR portal.

Employees working remotely are expected to be available during core business hours, from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., and must attend all scheduled video meetings with their camera on. Remote work privileges may be suspended for employees who do not meet performance expectations, as determined by their manager during quarterly reviews.

This policy applies to all departments except Customer Support, which requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of its operations. Questions about this policy should be directed to your HR business partner.
statement: What is this notice mainly about?
choices: A change to the company's remote work rules
The elimination of remote work altogether
A new performance review process
A change in office opening hours

explanation.why_correct: Le texte annonce explicitement une mise à jour de la politique de télétravail ('the company is updating its remote work policy').
why_others_wrong: Le texte n'élimine pas le télétravail, il l'étend au contraire (de deux à trois jours par semaine).
Les évaluations trimestrielles ne sont mentionnées qu'en lien avec la suspension possible du télétravail, ce n'est pas le sujet principal.
Le texte ne mentionne pas de changement des horaires d'ouverture du bureau, seulement les horaires de disponibilité en télétravail.
explanation.method: Le titre en majuscules ('UPDATED REMOTE WORK POLICY') annonce directement le sujet principal du document.

passage:
BUSINESS BRIEF

Northfield Logistics announced on Tuesday that it has completed its acquisition of regional carrier Swift Transit for an undisclosed sum. The deal, first announced in June, will allow Northfield to expand its delivery network into three new states and add approximately 200 vehicles to its fleet.

Swift Transit will continue to operate under its own brand name for the next twelve months before being fully integrated into Northfield's operations. All 340 Swift Transit employees will be offered positions within the combined company, according to a statement released by Northfield's CEO, who called the acquisition 'a major step toward becoming a national logistics leader.' Analysts expect the merger to increase Northfield's annual revenue by roughly 18%.
statement: What is this news brief mainly reporting?
choices: A logistics company's completed acquisition of another company
A strike organized by transportation workers
The launch of a new delivery vehicle model
A decline in Northfield Logistics' annual revenue

explanation.why_correct: Le texte annonce que Northfield Logistics a finalisé l'acquisition de Swift Transit.
why_others_wrong: Aucune grève n'est mentionnée dans le texte.
Le texte ne concerne pas le lancement d'un nouveau modèle de véhicule, mais l'ajout de véhicules existants à la flotte.
Le texte indique au contraire une AUGMENTATION attendue du chiffre d'affaires, pas une baisse.
explanation.method: Dans une brève d'actualité économique, l'idée principale se trouve généralement dans la toute première phrase.

From: j.chen@apex-consulting.com
To: all-department-heads@apex-consulting.com
Subject: Rescheduled: Annual Strategy Conference

Dear Colleagues,

Due to a scheduling conflict with our venue, the Annual Strategy Conference originally planned for November 10-11 has been moved to November 17-18. The event will still take place at the Grandview Convention Center, and all previously registered sessions remain unchanged.

If you have already booked travel or accommodation for the original dates, please contact our travel coordinator, Lisa Ortiz, at l.ortiz@apex-consulting.com as soon as possible to arrange changes. Hotel rooms at the Grandview partner rate have been extended to cover the new dates, but availability is limited, so we encourage you to confirm your reservation by October 20.

The updated agenda, including this year's keynote speaker announcement, will be sent out next week. We apologize for any inconvenience this change may cause and appreciate your flexibility.

Best regards,
Jennifer Chen
Events Coordinator
statement: Why was this email sent?
choices: To cancel the Annual Strategy Conference
To inform staff of a change in the conference dates
To announce the keynote speaker for the conference
To request feedback on last year's conference

why_others_wrong: La conférence n'est pas annulée, seulement reportée à de nouvelles dates.
L'annonce du conférencier principal n'est mentionnée que comme une information à venir, pas l'objet de cet email.
Aucune demande de retour d'expérience n'est mentionnée dans le texte.
explanation.method: Le préfixe dans l'objet de l'email ('Rescheduled:') indique immédiatement la nature du message : un changement de programme.

Le 17 novembre correspond à la NOUVELLE date de début de la conférence, pas à la date limite pour confirmer une réservation d'hôtel.
Le 18 novembre correspond à la nouvelle date de fin de la conférence, pas à une date limite de réservation.
explanation.method: Ne pas confondre les différentes dates d'un texte : bien identifier laquelle correspond à une échéance ('by...') et lesquelles correspondent à l'événement lui-même.

Join us for a one-day intensive seminar designed for professionals who want to sharpen their negotiation skills in high-stakes business settings. Led by renowned negotiation expert Dr. Alan Reyes, this seminar covers practical techniques for handling difficult clients, closing deals under pressure, and managing cross-cultural negotiations.

Location: Meridian Business Center, Conference Room B

Price: $295 per person (includes lunch and course materials); early registration before October 15 receives a 20% discount.

Register online at www.reyesnegotiation.com/seminar or call (555) 812-3390. Group discounts are available for companies registering three or more employees.
statement: Who is this advertisement primarily intended for?
choices: New graduates looking for their first job
Business professionals wanting to improve negotiation skills
Companies looking to hire a negotiation expert as a consultant
Students studying international law

why_others_wrong: Le texte ne cible pas spécifiquement les jeunes diplômés à la recherche d'un premier emploi.
Le texte propose un séminaire de formation, pas l'embauche d'un consultant.
Le texte ne mentionne pas d'étudiants en droit international.

BUILDING NOTICE: SCHEDULED PARKING GARAGE MAINTENANCE

Please be advised that the underground parking garage at 450 Commerce Avenue will be closed for scheduled maintenance from Saturday, September 27, through Sunday, September 28. During this period, routine inspections and repairs will be performed on the garage's lighting and ventilation systems.

Tenants who normally park in the garage are asked to use the temporary parking lot located on Elm Street, two blocks north of the building, at no additional charge during the closure. Access badges will not be required for the temporary lot during this period.

The garage is expected to reopen at 6 a.m. on Monday, September 29. We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation.
statement: What is the purpose of this notice?
choices: To announce a permanent closure of the parking garage
To inform tenants of temporary parking arrangements during maintenance
To increase parking fees for all tenants
To announce a new tenant access badge system

explanation.why_correct: Le texte informe les locataires d'une fermeture temporaire du parking pour maintenance et propose une solution alternative de stationnement.
why_others_wrong: Le texte précise une date de réouverture ('expected to reopen...Monday'), ce n'est donc pas une fermeture permanente.
Le texte indique que le parking temporaire est gratuit, il n'est donc pas question d'augmentation de tarifs.
Le texte indique que les badges ne seront PAS nécessaires pour le parking temporaire pendant cette période ; ce n'est pas un nouveau système permanent.
explanation.method: Le titre du document ('BUILDING NOTICE: SCHEDULED...MAINTENANCE') annonce directement la nature temporaire et pratique de l'information.

statement: When is the parking garage expected to reopen?
choices: Saturday, September 27 at 6 a.m.
Sunday, September 28 at 6 a.m.
Monday, September 29 at 6 a.m.
Monday, September 29 at 6 p.m.

explanation.why_correct: Le texte précise : 'The garage is expected to reopen at 6 a.m. on Monday, September 29.'
why_others_wrong: Le samedi 27 septembre correspond au début de la fermeture, pas à la réouverture.
Le dimanche 28 septembre correspond à la fin annoncée de la période de fermeture, mais la réouverture effective est précisée pour le lundi.
Le texte précise '6 a.m.' (le matin), pas '6 p.m.' (le soir).
explanation.method: Bien lire les indications a.m./p.m. et vérifier soigneusement chaque date mentionnée pour éviter les pièges de confusion entre les jours de fermeture et de réouverture.
